newsitem.title: USA: US money mkt fund asets $984.46 bln July 16 wk-ICI.
newsitem.headline: US money mkt fund asets $984.46 bln July 16 wk-ICI.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended July 16 fell to $984.46 billion from a revised $987.28 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 669 retail money market mutual funds rose $399.8 million to $653.25 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 403 taxable money market funds rose $558.5 million to $535.09 billion, while assets of the 266 tax-exempt funds fell $158.7 million to $118.17 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 325 institutional money market funds fell $3.22 billion to $331.21 billion. Of these, assets of the 262 taxable money market funds fell $2.0 billion to $296.17 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds were off $1.21 billion to $35.04 billion, it said.
ICI revised total money market mutual fund assets for the previous week to $987.28 billion from $986.65 billion.
